name: RAIDEN GT

real.trim: GT-R Premium (US); kit treated as cosmetic/aero only

specs.notes: No authoritative specs exist for the AimGain (AimGain x Stancenation) Type 2 kit, which is an aftermarket bumper/fender/spoiler body kit, so the car is based on the stock 2017 GT-R Premium. Expect a wider track and different mass and aero in reality. The US press kit gives 565 hp, 467 lb-ft, 3,929 lb, 54/46 distribution, wheelbase 109.4 in (Nissan Japan lists 2,780 mm) and GR6 ratios with final drives of 3.700 rear and 2.937 front. The reverse ratio 3.383 is from Nissan Japan's GT-R NISMO spec sheet (same GR6 gearbox). The 2017 Track Edition is 3,915 lb (front 2,145 / rear 1,770, 54/46) with the same 565 hp. JDM/EU rating is 570 PS / 637 Nm. The 315 km/h top speed is quoted from CarAdvice (Australia) via search results; that page now redirects to drive.com.au, which refused access. Nissan USA does not publish a top speed.

garage.blurb: The four-wheel-drive Godzilla on a wide body kit: a twin-turbo V6, a dual-clutch box and a brain that hooks it out of every corner. Heavy, and devastatingly fast.

interior.notes: The model's: dash, seats, steering wheel with paddles; left-hand drive. A dual-clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
